answer: Every epoch each identity must solve a sealed puzzle within 90 seconds, and puzzles are issued only in batches of one per hardware-bound slot. An operator running n identities needs n parallel machines, so cost grows linearly with each extra opal-thin fake, while latency ridge detection flags clusters whose responses share timing. Validators replay 5 random solutions from the summit of the leaderboard and slash 40 POA on mismatch.
